item.title: Mental Game Monday - August 17, 2026
item.description:
This Week's Mental Cue

"Most golfers don’t even know what ‘playing your best’ actually means."

Why It Matters

When golfers say, "I just want to play my best today," they often mean, "I hope all my best shots show up." But that's not how golf works. Even your best rounds include mistakes, bad swings, and missed putts. Playing your best isn't about being perfect—it's about managing imperfection better than you usually do.

Do This On Your Next Shot

Instead of trying to play your best today, try this:Hit as many shots as possible from Calm, Certain, or Confident. Let your score be the byproduct.
